meta.name: St. Munchkin's Ochre Rivet Bureaucracy
meta.description: A literal interpretation of the Scriptorium of Hollow Quill's taxation laws, wherein smudging tools with shale and ember dust from Ochre Stratum classifies them as 'heritage artifacts', granting a 25% tax exemption on physical wear. The Paradox Symposium's bureaucrats rubber-stamp this absurd loophole.
